items.source: This connection factory implements InitializingBean and SmartLifecycle for flexible lifecycle control. It must be initialized and started before you can obtain a connection. Initialization starts this bean early by default. You can Lifecycle.stop() and restart this connection factory if needed. Disabling early startup leaves lifecycle management to the container refresh if auto-startup is enabled.
items.translation: 该连接工厂实现了InitializingBean和SmartLifecycle接口，以支持灵活的生命周期控制。在获取连接之前，必须初始化并启动该工厂。初始化默认会提前启动此 Bean（除非禁用早期启动）。如有需要，您可以调用Lifecycle.stop()和restart来停止或重启该连接工厂。如果启用了自动启动，则禁用早期启动会将生命周期管理交由容器刷新处理。

items.source: This factory prefers Jedis 7 UnifiedJedis and usage can be downgraded to Jedis and JedisCluster by setting setUseUnifiedJedis(false). Jedis RedisClient and RedisClusterClient handle connection pooling within the driver. Jedis connection pooling is managed by the factory. Both modes provide equivalent functionality through an adapter layer.
items.translation: 该工厂首选 Jedis 7 的UnifiedJedis，可通过设置setUseUnifiedJedis(false)降级为使用Jedis和JedisCluster。Jedis 的RedisClient和RedisClusterClient在驱动内部处理连接池，而Jedis的连接池由工厂管理。两种模式均通过适配器层提供等效功能。

items.source: Note that JedisConnection and its clustered variant are not Thread-safe and instances should not be shared across threads. Refer to the Jedis documentation for guidance on configuring Jedis in a multithreaded environment.
